1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches rather than continuous strips__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied in a wrapped configuration around the filler__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the fabric patches are positioned to avoid continuous coverage along the length of the radius areas__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix, __and wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches that are spaced apart from one another__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __provided that the adhesive layer comprises a structural adhesive sheet that is wrapped around the filler and the composite fabric patches are discrete and non-continuous__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset fabric layers are applied as discrete patches positioned at different locations along the members__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches positioned at the radius areas rather than as continuous strips__, and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied in a wrapped configuration__.

8. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein each of the composite channels and the base includes laminated composite tape with reinforcing fibers, __and wherein the reinforcing fibers are unidirectional__.

9. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers, __and wherein the woven bidirectional fibers are applied as discrete patches__.

10. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 9, wherein the bidirectional reinforcing fibers are graphite, __and wherein the graphite fibers are held in an epoxy matrix__.

11. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __and__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein the patches are discrete and non-overlapping__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the wrapped adhesive sheet is applied in a configuration that does not form continuous coverage along the entire length of the filler__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __provided that the adhesive is applied as a structural adhesive sheet in a wrapped configuration that maintains discrete patch positioning of the composite fabric__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are C-shaped in cross-section, __and wherein the composite fabric patches are positioned at the radius areas between the web and flanges of each C-shaped channel__.

16. (Original) A method of fabricating a composite stiffener, comprising: forming a pair of composite channels each having a flange and a radius portion, using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over the radius portion of each of the channels; forming a base using composite fiber tape; placing a reinforcing filler in at least a portion of the base; placing a layer of adhesive around a filler; assembling the channels and base to form a radius filler zone between the radius portions of the channels and the base; and, curing the assembly.

17. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the forming of the channels includes laying up unidirectional reinforcing fibers.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein placing the adhesive includes wrapping the filler with a sheet of adhesive.

19. (Original) The method of claim 16, further comprising: placing layers of composite fiber fabric on sections of each of the channels, the base and the cap outside the radius filler zone; and, introducing a layer of adhesive between the layers of composite fiber fabric on the sections outside the radius filler zone.

20. (Currently amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, __with discrete patches of__ laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; joining a surface of the cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches__; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied in a wrapped configuration__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels, __wherein the patches are discrete and non-continuous__.

22. (Original) The method of claim 21, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of each of the first and second channels; introducing an adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Original) The method of claim 20, wherein using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler.

24. (Currently amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C-channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches positioned at the radius filler zones__; wrapping a reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive; placing the reinforcing filler and the adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, __wherein the cap and base include radius areas between the web and the flanges and are formed from laminated composite tape plies__, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches positioned at the radius areas__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the adhesive is applied in a wrapped configuration around the filler__.
